crime: {WITCH_NAME} avoided the lake. She told one girl why: her sister had drowned holding her hand. At dinner, that girl whispered to a neighbor, and the story passed down the table with each listener turning to look.

{WITCH_NAME} changed seats and routes to avoid her. The girl kept cornering her, often shoving first and speaking afterward. That day she demanded that {WITCH_NAME} confirm the story before everyone or hear it told again.

At dusk, {WITCH_NAME} waited with her back to the upstairs railing above the courtyard, on the girl's usual route. The girl came and shoved with both hands. The push missed. Her hips struck the railing, and she toppled over it onto the stone below.

A girl in the courtyard had seen the outstretched arms and the lone fall. {WITCH_NAME} claimed she was already in the library before the scream, but the prisoner shelving books had seen her rush in afterward. The library's only door opened onto that railing. She had come from the place where the shove missed.
fields.epitaph: Everything thrown at her missed; what found her was never thrown.
execution: An iron floor lay within a smooth, waist-high wall. She stood unbound on it as it began to heat. She could move, but every part of the floor grew equally hot. The temperature kept rising until she fell onto the plate and lay still.
